title: Divided left battles rising far right as France heads to the polls
summary: PRESS REVIEW: Wednesday, March 11 – we look at evidence that the strike on a girls’ school in Minab was carried out by a US missile. In other news, France heads to the polls in council elections with a fractured left wing and a far right hoping for sweeping gains. And finally, new findings could pave the way for improving hedgehog road safety.
